name: ACCIDENT @ CVPR
description: Traffic surveillance cameras capture accidents continuously, yet converting raw CCTV footage into structured event records that pinpoint when, where, and what type of collision occurred remains unsolved at scale. The ACCIDENT @ CVPR benchmark evaluates exactly this joint prediction under a strict constraint: no labeled real-world training data is available. We introduce a training-free, two-pass coarse-to-fine pipeline that pairs a frozen Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct vision-language model with YOLO11x object detection and BoT-SORT tracking.
